name: @listen-fire/legacy-lang
description: The TypeScript parser, checker, editor service and story for language versions 1 to 5, with their conformance corpora. Platform-only; the language packages never import it. Its tests borrow apps/api's jest runner (jest.config.borrowed.cjs)

scripts.harvest:programs: T=$(mktemp -d) && for c in v1 v2 v3 current; do HARVEST_CORPUS=$c HARVEST_OUT=$T/$c.jsonl node ../../apps/api/node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config parser/harvest/jest.harvest.cjs || exit 1; done && node parser/harvest/build_fixture.cjs v1=$T/v1.jsonl v2=$T/v2.jsonl v3=$T/v3.jsonl current=$T/current.jsonl
scripts.harvest:slots: T=$(mktemp -d) && for c in v1 v2 v3 current; do HARVEST_CORPUS=$c HARVEST_OUT=$T/$c.jsonl node ../../apps/api/node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config parser/expression/harvest/jest.harvest.cjs || exit 1; done && node parser/expression/harvest/build_fixture.cjs v1=$T/v1.jsonl v2=$T/v2.jsonl v3=$T/v3.jsonl current=$T/current.jsonl
